text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hoping it might help guide <chrname>, I came out 
today to observe the other students' 
training.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
――Pheeew~~, I am so exhausted~~! That was 
brutal~~~...!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Alright, alright, three more laps~~! Don't 
you stop now~~~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I hear ya, I hear ya~~. Besides, you're 
the one who stopped running.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Jeez, you guys are messing around way too 
much. I'm heading on ahead~♪ Later, 
losers~!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Aah~! Wait up~!! Ahahaha~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just like ordinary schoolgirls you'd see 
anywhere, they fool around together. There 
is nothing particularly noteworthy...
choice_data_list: (No, this is the renowned Tracen Academy!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Despite how they look, they're an elite 
bunch who conquered rigorous entrance 
exams. Perhaps that relaxed nature of 
theirs is the secret to their strength!
choice_data_list:
Let's ask for more details about the 
training menu.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
—Umm... Here is the menu for this week. 
Nothing out of the ordinary.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
All I did was adjust the template from the 
handout we got in class to match her 
aptitudes and distances...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Um, did that help... give you some ideas?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, I wonder if that's true~? I mean, 
aren't there tons of amazing girls at this 
academy?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I'm really not doing anything that 
special... Just, you know, trying my best 
as usual.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Say, how about giving me some advice 
instead?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Somethin' not too grueling~, where I can 
just get strong real quick~...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Well, I know it's asking for a lot, but... 
is there anything like that available? 
Ehehe...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Miracle asked half-jokingly. I gave 
a relaxed reply in kind.
choice_data_list: Taking moderate breaks is important, too.
Let's take things at our own pace!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ah~, that makes sense~. They do say 
fatigue ruins your efficiency, after all.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Hearing you say that makes me feel a lot 
less guilty about taking a rest day.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, resting is super important~. Sooo, 
let's wrap it up around here for today.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Thanks for your hard work~♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Tracen Academy is full of extraordinary 
girls. But I learned today that there are 
students like this, too.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I see~. Pushing yourself too hard isn't 
sustainable, after all.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"Consistency is key," and to achieve that, 
"don't overexert yourself." In other 
words...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Normal is best! That's how it goes, right? 
I'll just keep doing my best at my own 
pace~

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Tracen Academy is full of extraordinary 
girls. But I learned today that there are 
students like this, too.
